Translate.requestParamsDescription:
### Scenario Description  
We provide different engines optimized specifically for various scenarios. You can control which engine to use by specifying the scene parameter. Valid values for the scene parameter include: product title (title), product description (description), product communication (communication), medical (medical), social (social), and finance (finance).  

- **Product Title**: This engine is trained exclusively on Alibaba's e-commerce product title data and delivers excellent performance for translating product titles.  
- **Product Description**: Trained specifically on Alibaba's detailed product description data, this engine excels at translating comprehensive product descriptions.  
- **Product Communication**: Optimized for buyer-seller communication scenarios in e-commerce, this engine provides high-quality translations for conversational content.  
- **Medical**: This engine is specially trained on medical literature, terminology, and pharmaceutical data, ensuring superior translation quality in medical contexts.  
- **Social**: Designed for colloquial and informal language, this engine produces natural-sounding translations suitable for social interactions.  
- **Finance**: Tailored for the finance domain, this engine delivers accurate translations of financial content.

TranslateImage.title: Image Translation
TranslateImage.description:
Before using this API, ensure you fully understand the [pricing and billing model](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163332.html) of the Image Translation product.

This API supports **general image translation** and **e-commerce image translation**.  
For certificate translation, refer to the [Certificate Translation Integration Guide](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2505939.html).

**Image Restrictions**

- File Size limit: 10 MB  
- Pixel aspect ratio limit: width-to-height ratio < 10:1  
- Supported formats: jpg, jpeg, png, bmp, gif (only the first frame is translated), webp

> This API supports invocation only via POST requests.

changeSet.description: Error codes changed, Response parameters changed

TranslateImageBatch.summary: Asynchronously translates text in a batch of images from one language to another and returns a new image for each input image.

schema.description: URLs of the source images. Separate multiple URLs with commas. A single request can include up to 20 URLs. Duplicate URLs are processed only once.
Source language. For supported languages and their codes, see [language codes](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163584.html).
Target language. For supported languages and their codes, see [language codes](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163584.html).

Extended information in JSON string format. Supported fields include the following.

- needEditorData: Set to `true` or `false`. Default is `false`. Set to `true` to return editor data in the response. Use this only when you integrate your own [image translation post-editing editor](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2507676.html).

- ignoreEntityRecognize: Set to `true` or `false`. Default is `false`. For e-commerce image translation, the service automatically detects whether text appears on product entities in the image. If so, it skips translation. Set this field to `true` to disable that detection. This field has no effect on general image translation.
Custom task ID. Prevent accidental duplicate requests within a short time. Requests with the same custom task ID are processed only once within three minutes.

Translation domain. Valid values:

- `general`: General image translation

- `e-commerce`: E-commerce image translation

If not specified or unrecognized, the service uses general image translation.
